summary: Clear and traceable four-retailer stress ranking with useful sensitivities; conclusions are robust only within a small, manually chosen peer set and simplified obligation model.

artifactRatings.rationale: Filed metrics and score arithmetic support the within-peer ranking, but coarse percentiles and omitted maturities, credit access, and current lease obligations limit broader resilience claims.
Ranking, peer set, criteria, filing metrics, source tags, alternative weighting, stress scenario, and uncertainty are all included.
Context alignment and transparent formulas are strong; four-company rank scoring is mechanically coarse and the uniform CFO shock preserves most orderings by construction.
Raw facts, accessions, tags, periods, derived ratios, and a companion metrics CSV provide strong traceability.
The report explicitly frames scores as relative rather than default probabilities and details peer, lease, scale, stress, and data limitations.
